note: Small, quiet Hoosier NF campground on a wooded ridge above Saddle Lake, a 41-acre flood-control lake on the Middle Fork of the Anderson River, Tell City Ranger District. A boat ramp nearby and a 2.4-mile trail around the lake; often deserted. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $5, first-come, 13 sites, vault toilet, no hookups; 9 sites fit 23 ft (longest 43 ft). Water stays not waterfront: sites plot ~400 m from the lake on a wooded ridge. USFS page gives the area as year-round but says nothing about the campground itself, so season left unset.
flags: WEBSITE: stored is recreation.gov only; the agency's page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hoosier/recreation/saddle-lake-recreation-area (apply.py writes no website).

WATERFRONT confirmed not waterfront: recreation.gov per-site coordinates (site 1 38.06088,-86.654518; site 9 38.060831,-86.655596; site 13 38.060535,-86.656422) on Esri imagery sit under canopy on the ridge; nearest lake arm is ~400 m NW of site 13, so no view claim. rec.gov's 'Views of Saddle Lake' is an area description, not a per-site fact.

PIN fine: stored 38.060954,-86.655278 sits among the plotted sites. The USFS page's two coordinate pairs (38.05028,-86.64738 and 38.05935,-86.65262) are off the campground: the second is on the access road ~280 m SE.

Live status: USFS shows 'Site Open'; the forest alerts listed (Tower Ridge Road, Peninsula Trail, Tipsaw bridge) are not on this road. Road surface not stated by the agency; gravel-looking forest road on imagery, no 4WD or rig warning anywhere read.
